originality.rationale: Searched arXiv via API with proxy bypass and fetched primary sources: 1507.02955 (IMW NP-hardness/saturation holes) proves deciding positivity is NP-hard and gives no fixed-n table or M(12); 1406.2988 (Pak-Panova bounds/stability) proves general bounds not shown tight at n=12 and implies no vanishing census; 1601.04325 (Baldoni-Vergne-Walter dilated residues) gives single-ray symbolic formulas, not a full fixed-n cube via MN class sums; 1811.10967 (Ikenmeyer Saxl triple-hooks) covers staircase tensor squares with reductions to n_3=14/n_4=28, disjoint because n=12 is non-triangular (triangular numbers 10,15 bracket 12, so no staircase partition of 12); 2207.02561 (Pak-Panova Durfee/superexponential) proves polynomial growth at fixed Durfee size and superexponential growth of self-conjugate maxima asymptotically, not the exact value M(12)=945; 0907.3351 (rectangular stabilization) and 2306.04734 (ML zero/nonzero prediction with heuristic accuracy) are complementary (asymptotic subfamily and heuristic classifier vs exact certificates). Title search ti:Kronecker coefficients returned only these plus asymptotics/growth/crystals with no exhaustive n=12 S3-reduced census. Internal prior scan (3 validated Resultary findings on 4-uniform families, J2-free rank, spider walks; 9 SCOPE failures) is materially disjoint in objects/methods. No prior gives the triple (V,N)=(30336,48743) over 79079 orbits, M(12)=945 with per-class certificate, or Durfee/dominance breakdown. Folklore Sage/GAP one-liners can compute individual values but are unpublished without certificates; the claimed delta is explicitly only the first independently recheckable census with extremal certificate plus predictor analysis, not a new method, which is modest and not refuted by a one-liner objection.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as falsifiable ground truth where theory is silent: NP-hardness says no simple polyhedral vanishing criterion exists, Pak-Panova-type bounds are shown here to be far from tight at the maximum (trivial dim bound 7700 vs actual 945, ~12%), and ML predictors give only heuristic accuracy, so an exhaustive exact table matters. Content exceeds raw enumeration: (i) extremal witness M(12)=945 uniquely at the self-conjugate max-dim Durfee-3 shape (5,3,2,1,1)^3 with 77-term exact certificate recomputable from the triple alone; (ii) vanishing fraction 38.3616% unordered (38.6662% ordered) with full Durfee-profile breakdown showing high-Durfee blocks nearly always nonzero (2,3,3:4.4%, 3,3,3:4.1%) vs hook-heavy blocks mostly vanishing, including a clean 780/780 100%-vanishing (1,1,3) pocket; (iii) dominance analysis reversing the naive heuristic (more comparable => more likely to vanish: 9.9%/19.0%/35.5%/41.3% for 0/1/2/3 comparable pairs) with 22367 fully-comparable zeros and 390 incomparable nonzeros. Choice of n=12 is motivated (first p(n)=77>70, no staircase anchor, rectangular/self-conjugate/Durfee-3 interaction), not mere n=11->12 substitution. Not a textbook restatement (no textbook gives this census), not a tiny gain, and not an unexplained dump (certificates + bound-tightness test + predictor confusion). Single-n computational scope is honestly limited and does not resolve hardness/Saxl/GCT, but supplies data those theories must fit; any future combinatorial formula must reproduce M(12) and the vanishing pattern.
